entry.title: New: Bill 11 (2025) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
“A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2025 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, APPENDIX A, PART I, DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS, UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE, NATURAL RESOURCES CONSERVATION SERVICE ADDITIONAL FUNDING” The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2025 Budget, to increase the appropriation under the Department of Public Works entitled “United States Department of Agriculture, Natural Resources Conservation Service” by $2,574,250.
